ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; note the driver's 'I'm Here' press does not satisfy the GPS-at-pickup requirement, and remind the driver that the arrival button may only be used when GPS confirms arrival at the pickup point.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's claim of a valid rider no-show fails NS-1 (ii): per the GPS trace the driver was ~400 m from the pickup when he pressed 'I'm Here' at 13:02:45, and only entered the 200 m radius around 13:02:30; his own chat/statement are overridden by the system GPS record. NS-1 (iii) is also short (13:02:45→13:05:40 = 2 min 55 s).
